facts.text: Sam went on a hiking trip with friends last Friday.

evidence.quote: I’m really getting into this healthier lifestyle—just took my friends on an epic hiking trip last Friday!

facts.text: Evan and others had a car accident on the way back from a mountain drive.

evidence.quote: We took the Prius for a long drive to the mountains last weekend. It was perfect until we got into a little scrape on the way back.

facts.text: Evan was unharmed in the accident but it affected his ability to share the news of his upcoming marriage with work friends.

evidence.quote: Just a minor accident, but it put a bit of a damper on telling my work friends about getting married.

facts.text: Evan's work friends have been supportive of his upcoming marriage.

evidence.quote: They’ve been a great support, though.
